name: Pork BBQ Grill (Foukou) + skewers
note: ⏰ Punctuality Required: You are the Master of Skewers! Arrive on time to help prep the meat—a hungry crowd up in the pine trees is not a forgiving crowd.

name: Coal + Solid Firelighters (στερεό πετρέλαιο) + Tongs
note: ⏰ Punctuality Required: If you pick this, be on time! Otherwise, everyone will know exactly whose name to chant when hanger strikes at 13:30.

name: Foil Trays
note: Essential for general grillmaster operations.

name: Thermos for souvlakia
note: Essential for keeping cooked souvlakia warm until serving time.

name: Ice Cooler + Ice
note: Please coordinate directly with whoever is on drinks duty so we achieve peak cooler equilibrium and keep the drinks cold.

name: Single Use Plates
note: Biodegradable/sturdy paper plates preferred.

name: Single Use Cups
note: For cold drinks & beer.

name: Napkins
note: Paper napkins.

name: Kitchen Roll
note: Heavy duty paper towels.

name: Dish Detergent + Sponge + Trash Bags
note: Clean-up essentials to leave Trooditisa spotless!

name: Tablecloth
note: Disposable or washable picnic table cover.

name: Seftalies
note: Bring 3 packs of 10 of these juicy Cyprus classics for the grill.

name: Beers x 6/8 (4 packs needed)
note: Target is ~30 beers (about 2 per person). Pre-chill them at home, and ideally coordinate a pre-game pit stop with the Cooler Boss so cold beer meets ice before we hit the mountains!

name: Sparkling Water or sodas (pack of 6)
note: Fizzy refreshment for the non-beer crowd—chill it with the cooler.

name: Fresh Summer Fruits
note: 🍉 Nature's Sugar Rush: Bring juicy summer fruit (watermelon, nectarines, grapes) to revive everyone from their inevitable meat comas!

name: Halloumi
note: For grilling—the squeaky Cyprus classic everyone fights over.

name: Table Salt
note: To season cooked skewers.

name: Onions (for salad & skewers)
note: Thinly sliced for Cyprus salad & pita stuffing.

name: Lemons
note: Plenty of fresh Cyprus lemons for the souvlakia!

name: Tomatoes
note: Ripe & firm for salads.

name: Cucumbers
note: Fresh local cucumbers.

name: Cabbage
note: Shredded and ready to go

name: Cypriot Pitta Bread
note: Fresh pitta to stuff warm souvlakia into.

name: Fresh Parsley
note: Best to chop it beforehand if you can coordiante with the cooler bringer

name: Tzatziki
note: You don't have to make it, just bring it

name: Tahini
note: You don;t have to make it, just bring it

name: Packs of Nuts
note: Mixed nuts or peanuts for snacking.

name: Packs of Crisps
note: 3 packs of delicious crisps.

name: Snack a Jacks Rice Cakes
note: Something to munch on while we cook
